about_the_game:
You wake up, alone, in an underwater bunker. The walls hum with distant machinery. Water presses against the window outside. You have no memory of how you got here — only a voice.

Meet Ed, a friendly robot who greets you as you open your eyes. Ed claims to be your helper, your guide — maybe even your friend. Together, you begin exploring the cold bunker that has now become your home. As you search its corridors, you start piecing together fragments of what happened through letters, documents, and old data logs left behind by those who came before.

But soon, another voice breaks through the static: Ev.
Ev knows things Ed doesn’t want you to hear. Two robots. Two opposing truths. And only you can decide who to trust.

Explore the underwater bunker, uncover its mysteries, and survive in its decaying depths. Solve intricate puzzles — from decrypting corrupted data and rewiring power systems to unlocking sealed areas hiding the truth. But be careful: not every task is as harmless as it seems, and every system you restore might bring you closer to something you can’t control.
